11.rudransh: In Rosenau, Roland Rudransh was a carpenter. In S-S2, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a carpenter again.
Roland Rudransh read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.

A round went through the rim of Roland Rudransh's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Mw of the Concord (@m.w_1254). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Roland Rudransh during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
aegisdirectivee: Otto Aegisdirecti, a tram conductor from Coldwater, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in S-C8. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Otto Aegisdirecti during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
aubrey.macdonald: By the time Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald reached R-S13, the war was 6 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
Fog hid the far end of R-S13. Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.

The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald. Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jakub Fts of the Concord and Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Sorrow Copse for a week. Both trenches keep score. Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald. Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald crawled the last yards. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald. Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
fisher_926: Edmund Fisher unpacked a photograph gone soft at the edges at T-S10. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Edmund Fisher kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
gm_elox: The sergeant gave Marek Elox a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

Marek Elox let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Dorian "Crow" Ham was gravely wounded. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Marek Elox folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
jakesg132: Teodor "Hollow" Jakesg, a printer's apprentice from Lindenbruck, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in S-R5. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Teodor "Hollow" Jakesg kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
justindavol: Clement Justindavol found a place in U-F16 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
k4a.gr: Felix Kagr signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Felix Kagr answered the first call, number 4 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Felix Kagr did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Felix Kagr lent Bastian "Lucky" Vpy a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Felix Kagr and Bastian "Lucky" Vpy divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

Felix Kagr fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. After the loss of Hill 304, Felix Kagr helped stack spare sandbags at R-F12. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Felix Kagr sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.

A sniper's bullet hit Felix Kagr at R-F12. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Freddie of the Hegemony (@0__freddie__0). Felix Kagr fired at a movement across the wire at R-F12. The man went down: Viktor Kvasnicka, grazed. Felix Kagr was killed outright at R-F12, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Freddie of the Hegemony (@0__freddie__0).

The House of Kagr sent Konrad "Crow" Kagr after Felix Kagr. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. One of the first hundred, Konrad "Crow" Kagr was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the paper that came with it in oilcloth to keep it safe.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Konrad "Crow" Kagr. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Konrad "Crow" Kagr (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at the Brickworks. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Benedikt Datoneperson: 'Fair trade.'

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F12 in the middle of the night. Konrad "Crow" Kagr met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Dorian Austintress of the Hegemony (@austintress).

Leopold "Whistle" Kagr took the same post at R-F12 where Konrad "Crow" Kagr stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. As one of the first hundred volunteers, Leopold "Whistle" Kagr received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch.
remington.rosing: Jakub Rosing, a tram conductor from Tannenfeld, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-R12. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Jakub Rosing watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
rotrek_rock: Nobody asked Anselm "Parson" Rock why he came. Nobody in R-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Anselm "Parson" Rock was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F9 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Anselm "Parson" Rock reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Anselm "Parson" Rock's name scratched on it. Gustav "Tin" Jul kicked it back. It did not come again.

Otto Commanderchr and Anselm "Parson" Rock divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Anselm "Parson" Rock during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Anselm "Parson" Rock tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

A clear shot from R-F9. Anselm "Parson" Rock gravely wounded Roland "Ash" Hud and slid back down below the parapet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Anselm "Parson" Rock. Anselm "Parson" Rock read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The men argued about whether fish sleep. Anselm "Parson" Rock said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Anselm "Parson" Rock watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A single shot from across the wire hit Anselm "Parson" Rock in the thigh at R-F9. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Karel Check of the Hegemony (@no_one_here_to_check). Anselm "Parson" Rock looked over the parapet at R-F9 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Karel Check of the Hegemony (@no_one_here_to_check).

The papers say Hugo Rock. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Anselm "Parson" Rock's eyes. Nobody in R-F9 argues. Hugo Rock answered the first call, number 88 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Fog hid the far end of R-F9. Hugo Rock kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F9 and grazed Hugo Rock's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Marek Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu).
Hugo Rock returned to R-F9 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

A bullet grazed Hugo Rock's ribs at R-F9. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina of the Hegemony (@aloofcardinal). News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-F9 with the rations. Hugo Rock ate while listening to the revised orders.
